shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head and torso
disc or circular ornament on the chest/garment
necklace or collar band across the chest
carved surface detail indicating hair or textile texture
justification: Both depict a single human figure from the head down through the shoulders/chest, wearing a tall headdress and bearing a circular ornament and banded collar or belt across the torso, which is a mildly specific correspondence. But A is a blocky frontal, highly schematic figure with only summary incised markings, while B is a finely modelled profile head with elaborately conventionalised curled beard and hair rendered as rows of beads and a garment strewn with rosettes; the viewpoint, proportions and detailing conventions have little in common.
